author: EVEREX
quote: The graphics, realism, and gameplay are great, but the story and characters, especially Jason, are disappointing. After 13 years of waiting, I expected much more. Bugs and glitches are everywhere, and being locked to 30 FPS makes the experience worse. They could have easily added Performance Mode (60 FPS) and Quality Mode (30 FPS). Overall, it’s a disappointing experience that doesn’t justify the wait.
